motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and disclosure state only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; background: oklch(0.47 0.105 188); color: oklch(1 0 0); font: 650 0.875rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.39 0.095 188); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.47 0.105 188); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.010 200); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.20 0.018 200); font: 650 0.875rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.965 0.006 190); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.47 0.105 188); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Explicit written state with semantic color.
components.css: .ds-status-pending { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; background: oklch(0.63 0.14 65); color: oklch(1 0 0); font: 650 0.8125rem/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Repository Chip
components.description: Hard repository identity in evidence lists.
components.css: .ds-repo-chip { display: inline-flex; max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; background: oklch(0.965 0.006 190); color: oklch(0.20 0.018 200); font: 520 0.8125rem/1.4 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Status Navigation
components.html: Pending 2Approved 0
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.010 200); } .ds-tab { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: oklch(0.46 0.025 200); text-decoration: none; font: 650 0.875rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-active { color: oklch(0.20 0.018 200); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 oklch(0.47 0.105 188); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.47 0.105 188); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A well-lit review desk where source evidence, proposed relationships, and deliberate decisions each have a stable place. The surface is compact, familiar, and explicit.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Color communicates a current state or an available action, never atmosphere.

rules.name: The One Scale Rule
rules.body: Responsive behavior changes layout, not heading size.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: If a container needs a large shadow, its hierarchy or spacing is wrong.

dos: Do use pure white and cool neutral surfaces.
Do label every semantic state in text.
Do preserve native controls and visible focus.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS metric-card grids.
Don't use crypto neon or terminal cosplay.
Don't hide approval consequences behind vague labels.
